note: Pin manifest for SparkGLM 0.3.6 as republished on 2026-11-25, recipe linux-nvidia-dgx-spark-glm53-atlas version 8. Same release as pins-0.3.6.json (version 7) with two changes. The product's own launchers default to Spark mode; this recipe already sets SPARKGLM_MODE=spark, so what it serves is unchanged. The engine is Enntity/atlas spark 6bb95b52, 0.3.6's engine (01d34b34) plus Enntity/atlas#38, a build-time attestation test fix with no serving change, so the image's full-suite release check passes. Checkpoints, profiles, drafters and the switches the image sets are those of 0.3.6. image.reference is the GHCR manifest digest, also tagged ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkglm:0.3.6; the tag is the first 12 characters of the sparkglm install/ tree. On 2026-11-25 the image resolved an unset mode to Spark with the DFlash2 drafter; it was not run on a pair, because the pairs were serving.
